candidates.title: JustFit: 200K-Token LLM Serving on a 24 GiB Laptop with Just-in-Time State Management
candidates.reason: MLX-based local inference runtime combining compressed KV execution, component residency switching, and state-preserving serving transitions to sustain 200K-token contexts within 24 GiB; directly relevant to constrained-memory inference and offload/runtime design.

candidates.title: ECHO: Early-layer Collaborative Hierarchical Orchestration with Bonus Logits in Speculative Decoding
candidates.reason: Draft-model-free speculative decoding system targeting stale draft candidates and verification cost by exploiting early-layer functional asymmetry; relevant to decode acceleration and verification scheduling.

candidates.title: End-to-End Latency-Minimizing and Load-Balanced Request Scheduling for Edge LLM Inference in Agentic AI Services
candidates.reason: Request scheduling for distributed edge LLM inference under heterogeneous communication/compute and evolving inference state; directly relevant to serving latency and load balancing for agentic workloads.

candidates.title: GrowMTP: Efficient Multi-Token Prediction via Progressive Growth
candidates.reason: Progressively grows multi-token-prediction depth to reduce redundant training computation while retaining multi-token speculative inference benefits; reports substantial training and inference acceleration and fits training/inference co-design scope.

candidates.title: LIMBO: Lifelong Inference-Time Memory and Budget Optimization for LLM Agents
candidates.reason: Treats replay memory as a controllable inference-time resource and jointly allocates memory strategy and compute budget online without weight updates; reports up to about 83% lower inference cost against strong memory-augmented baselines.

discovery_stats.query_summary: Fresh September 15-16 arXiv search across LLM inference, speculative decoding, memory, KV cache, edge serving, and constrained-memory runtime axes after exact identity-snapshot filtering.
